panels.description: 模块导航。Grafana 原生没有 Tab，使用文本链接等价实现；当前页加粗。

options.content: 01 总览02 请求明细03 上游节点04 用户与密钥05 宿主与应用

panels.title: 网关 QPS
panels.description: 网关请求速率（含 0-attempt 失败）；不是上游 attempt 速率。重试会让上游 attempt 高于此值。

panels.title: 成功率（1h）
panels.description: 1h 内 M-10 成功网关请求占比。业务失败可能发生在已写出 200 的 SSE 中，不能只看 HTTP 5xx。

panels.title: P95 总耗时
panels.description: PG 请求样本 total_ms 的 P95。样本受落库覆盖率影响；不是各段 P95 相加。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_ms) / 1000.0 AS "P95 总耗时"
FROM ops_request_transfer_samples
WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at)

panels.title: P95 TTFT
panels.description: 最终 attempt 首次发送到尾响应首字节；与 upstream 重叠，不参与段堆叠。无首字节不观察。

panels.title: 入向带宽
panels.description: 当前 $__range 内客户端请求体 in_wire 实际读取字节平均速率；gzip 按压缩后长度计，不使用 Content-Length。

panels.title: 出向带宽
panels.description: 当前 $__range 内实际写给客户端的响应体平均速率。客户端慢读/断开会让该值低于上游返回量。

panels.title: 上游放大比
panels.description: 当前 $__range 内 resp_upstream / resp_downstream。>1.2 可能是客户端 abort、协议转换或流式重写；不能单独定性截断。

panels.title: 数据完整性
panels.description: M-9 request 覆盖率。0~1 比例；-1 表示无样本，不是 0% 或成功率。

panels.title: 链路段耗时占比
panels.description: PG 请求样本的 6 个互斥段平均耗时，Grafana 按 100% 堆叠归一化；headers_end 与 upstream 重叠，不在此面板。各段 P95 不可相加。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT '链路段耗时占比' AS "分类",
       avg(body_read_ms) AS "读取请求体",
       avg(wait_ms) AS "槽位等待",
       avg(gateway_ms) AS "网关本地",
       avg(upstream_ms) AS "上游耗时",
       avg(response_ms) AS "响应传输",
       avg(finish_ms) AS "收尾"
FROM ops_request_transfer_samples
WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at)

panels.title: 失败根因 Top 6
panels.description: 近 $__range 内 M-10 失败请求数 Top 6；无失败时无数据是健康状态，不是未采集。unknown 长期偏高说明分类缺失。

panels.title: 数据完整性
panels.description: 4 类 M-9 覆盖率（request/account/bytes/user）。<90% 黄；-1 灰=无样本；缺序列不等于健康。

panels.title: 最近异常请求
panels.description: PG 请求样本中最近的失败请求；点击详情定位该样本。样本量不代表总体分位。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  s.observed_at AS "时间",
  COALESCE(u.email, '#' || s.user_id) AS "用户",
  s.model AS "模型",
  s.total_ms AS "总耗时",
  (CASE s.failure_reason
  WHEN 'upstream_rate_limit' THEN '上游限流'
  WHEN 'upstream_server_error' THEN '上游 5xx'
  WHEN 'upstream_read_timeout' THEN '上游超时'
  WHEN 'client_abort_during_response' THEN '客户端中断'
  WHEN 'gateway_error' THEN '网关错误'
  WHEN 'rejected' THEN '请求被拒'
  WHEN 'unknown' THEN '未知'
  ELSE COALESCE(s.failure_reason, s.result, 'unknown')
END) AS "失败原因",
  s.id::text AS "详情"
FROM ops_request_transfer_samples s
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = s.user_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.observed_at)
  AND s.result <> 'success'
ORDER BY s.observed_at DESC, s.id DESC
LIMIT 8

panels.title: 上游账号速览
panels.description: PG 请求样本按账号聚合的 QPS/TTFT/失败率/带宽；不是 attempt 口径，低样本百分比噪声大。

targets.rawSql:
WITH win AS (
  SELECT s.account_id,
         max(COALESCE(s.platform, a.platform)) AS platform,
         count(*) AS requests,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.result <> 'success') * 100.0 / count(*) AS failure_pct,
         percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.headers_end_ms) / 1000.0 AS ttft_p95_s,
         sum(COALESCE(s.bytes_resp_downstream, 0)) / EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)) AS downstream_bps,
         mode() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY COALESCE(g.name, '—')) AS group_name
  FROM ops_request_transfer_samples s
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = s.account_id
  LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.id = s.group_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(s.observed_at)
    AND s.account_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.account_id
)
SELECT COALESCE(a.name, '#' || w.account_id) AS "账号",
       w.platform AS "平台",
       w.group_name AS "分组",
       round((w.requests / EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)))::numeric, 2) AS "QPS",
       round(w.ttft_p95_s::numeric, 2) AS "P95 TTFT",
       round(w.failure_pct::numeric, 1) AS "失败率",
       w.downstream_bps AS "带宽",
       CASE WHEN a.id IS NULL THEN '未知'
            WHEN a.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR a.status <> 'active' OR a.schedulable IS FALSE THEN '停用'
            WHEN a.overload_until > now() OR a.rate_limited_at > now() - interval '5 minutes' THEN '限流'
            WHEN w.failure_pct > 5 THEN '降权候选'
            WHEN w.failure_pct > 2 THEN '观察'
            ELSE '正常' END AS "状态"
FROM win w
LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = w.account_id
ORDER BY w.requests DESC
LIMIT 5
